summary: Accept Fractal gate evidence predicate URIs while preserving signed Smalltalk history

replay.detail: Existing signed evidence is read unchanged; no replay is needed.

schema.detail: The gate evidence v1 payload schema is unchanged.

rules.detail: Signature, trust and gate policy requirements are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Rust and Python verifiers accept https://compounding.tech/fractal/evidence/gate/v1 and permanently accept https://smalltalk.dev/evidence/gate/v1. Signers continue writing the old URI until the dual-URI verifier release is on main.

downtime.detail: Verifier-first rollout requires no downtime and preserves compatibility with existing signers.

manual.detail: No operator action is required for this verifier-only release.

recovery.detail: Existing signed records and signer output remain compatible with the previous release.
